quotes.text: Artificial intelligence offers real opportunities, but we need safeguards to protect privacy, cybersecurity, workers, intellectual property and the integrity of our elections. Congress should establish clear rules addressing discrimination, deceptive deepfakes and the misuse of personal information.

I’m also deeply concerned about the expansion of large data centers in the Lowcountry. These facilities consume enormous amounts of electricity and water, and residents should not be stuck paying for the infrastructure they require. [...] I support stronger environmental protections, transparency about resource consumption, protections against higher utility costs and local control over land-use decisions.

I support a moratorium on data centers in South Carolina. In Congress, I will fight for federal guardrails that put the costs on the corporations, protect our natural resources and give communities meaningful input before decisions are made.

.@JennyHoneycutt said it herself:

"Data centers can be extremely valuable."

Jenny owned $470,000 in stock for data center developers and AI companies. I support a moratorium on building data centers in South Carolina and believe we need federal guardrails to protect consumers. https://t.co/PAwlUeUBPr

Like I know how to lead. I know how to listen. I know how to deliver results, and I have a plan to deliver results for the Lowcountry where I think it’s pretty clear that my opponent has a plan to protect data centers,
